ucs.title: [LLM] APT32 (OceanLotus / Cobalt Kitty) DLL side-loading via vendor-signed host binaries dropped to user-writable paths
ucs.description: Hunts OceanLotus's signature 'Cobalt Kitty' initial-foothold pattern: a legitimately-signed third-party binary (Symantec wsc_proxy.exe, Symantec rastlsc.exe, McAfee mcoemcpy.exe, Kaspersky avpui.exe, Adobe AcroTranscoder.exe) dropped to %APPDATA% / %PROGRAMDATA% / %USERPROFILE% so that an adjacent malicious DLL (wsc.dll, McUtil.dll, goopdate.dll, dwmapi.dll) gets side-loaded via search-order hijack. CrowdStrike, ESET (SOUNDBITE/Salgorea) and Cybereason (Op Cobalt Kitty) all attribute this combination to APT32.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name IN ("wsc_proxy.exe","rastlsc.exe","rastls.exe","mcoemcpy.exe","mcvsmap.exe","avpui.exe","AcroTranscoder.exe","tcpvcfg.exe","outlook.exe","winword.exe") AND (Processes.process_path="*\\Users\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\ProgramData\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\AppData\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\Temp\\*" OR Processes.process_path="*\\Public\\*") AND NOT (Processes.process_path="C:\\Program Files\\*" OR Processes.process_path="C:\\Program Files (x86)\\*" OR Processes.process_path="C:\\Windows\\*") by host Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process_path Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process_path Processes.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | join type=left host process_path [| tstats summariesonly=t values(Filesystem.file_name) as sideloaded_dlls from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where Filesystem.file_name IN ("wsc.dll","wwlib.dll","McUtil.dll","goopdate.dll","goopdateres.dll","dwmapi.dll","version.dll","rastls.dll","mcvsmap.dll") by host Filesystem.file_path | rename Filesystem.file_path as process_path] | where isnotnull(sideloaded_dlls) | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let SideloadHosts = dynamic(["wsc_proxy.exe","rastlsc.exe","rastls.exe","mcoemcpy.exe","mcvsmap.exe","avpui.exe","acrotranscoder.exe","tcpvcfg.exe","outlook.exe","winword.exe"]);
let SideloadDlls = dynamic(["wsc.dll","wwlib.dll","mcutil.dll","goopdate.dll","goopdateres.dll","dwmapi.dll","version.dll","rastls.dll","mcvsmap.dll"]);
let HostExec = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName in~ SideloadHosts
    | where FolderPath has_any (@"\Users\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\AppData\", @"\Temp\", @"\Public\")
    | where FolderPath !startswith @"C:\Program Files"
    | where FolderPath !startswith @"C:\Program Files (x86)"
    | where FolderPath !startswith @"C:\Windows"
    | where AccountName !endswith "$"     // strip machine accounts
    | project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine, SHA256;
let AdjacentDll = DeviceImageLoadEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where FileName in~ SideloadDlls
    | where InitiatingProcessFolderPath has_any (@"\Users\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\AppData\", @"\Temp\", @"\Public\")
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ SideloadHosts
    | project Timestamp, DeviceId, DllName=FileName, DllFolder=FolderPath, LoaderImage=InitiatingProcessFileName, LoaderFolder=InitiatingProcessFolderPath, LoaderSHA256=InitiatingProcessSHA256;
HostExec
| join kind=inner (AdjacentDll) on DeviceId
| where FolderPath == DllFolder           // DLL sat next to the EXE — Windows search-order hijack
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, FolderPath, DllName, ProcessCommandLine, SHA256, LoaderSHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 14d;
let SideloadHosts = dynamic([@"\wsc_proxy.exe",@"\rastlsc.exe",@"\rastls.exe",@"\mcoemcpy.exe",@"\mcvsmap.exe",@"\avpui.exe",@"\AcroTranscoder.exe",@"\tcpvcfg.exe",@"\OUTLOOK.EXE",@"\WINWORD.EXE"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| where NewProcessName has_any (SideloadHosts)
| where NewProcessName has_any (@"\Users\", @"\ProgramData\", @"\AppData\", @"\Temp\", @"\Public\")
| where NewProcessName !contains @"\Program Files"
| where NewProcessName !contains @"\Windows\"
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, ParentProcessName, TokenElevationType
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: APT32 OceanLotus Side-Loader Host Binary Executed From User-Writable Path
id: 9b34c7a1-1d7e-4b6c-8e2f-0a3f1d5b9c11
status: experimental
description: Detects vendor-signed binaries known to be abused by APT32 (Cobalt Kitty) for DLL side-loading when they execute from %USERPROFILE%, %APPDATA% or %PROGRAMDATA% instead of their legitimate install path.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0050/
  - https://www.cybereason.com/blog/operation-cobalt-kitty-apt
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/19
tags:
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1574.002
  - attack.t1036.005
  - attack.g0050
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_binary:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\wsc_proxy.exe'
      - '\rastlsc.exe'
      - '\rastls.exe'
      - '\mcoemcpy.exe'
      - '\mcvsmap.exe'
      - '\avpui.exe'
      - '\AcroTranscoder.exe'
      - '\tcpvcfg.exe'
  selection_path:
    Image|contains:
      - '\Users\'
      - '\ProgramData\'
      - '\AppData\'
      - '\Temp\'
      - '\Public\'
  filter_legit:
    Image|contains:
      - '\Program Files\'
      - '\Program Files (x86)\'
      - '\Windows\'
  condition: selection_binary and selection_path and not filter_legit
falsepositives:
  - Vendor installer caching the binary in a user temp path during upgrade (verify by signer + install correlation)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @Image:(*\\wsc_proxy.exe OR *\\WSC_Proxy.exe OR *\\rastlsc.exe OR *\\RasTlsC.exe OR *\\rastls.exe OR *\\RasTls.exe OR *\\mcoemcpy.exe OR *\\McoeMcPy.exe OR *\\mcvsmap.exe OR *\\McVsMap.exe OR *\\AcroTranscoder.exe OR *\\acrotranscoder.exe OR *\\avpui.exe OR *\\AVPUI.exe OR *\\tcpvcfg.exe OR *\\TcpVcfg.exe) @Image:(*\\Users\\* OR *\\ProgramData\\* OR *\\AppData\\* OR *\\Temp\\* OR *\\Public\\*) -@Image:(*\\Program?Files\\* OR *\\Program?Files?\(x86\)\\* OR *\\Windows\\*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\(wsc_proxy|rastlsc|rastls|mcoemcpy|mcvsmap|avpui|acrotranscoder|tcpvcfg)\.exe$/i
| regex("\\\\(Users|ProgramData|AppData|Temp|Public)\\\\", field=ImageFileName)
| NOT regex("\\\\Program Files", field=ImageFileName)
| NOT regex("C:\\\\Windows\\\\", field=ImageFileName)
| join({#event_simpleName=ClassifiedModuleLoad OR #event_simpleName=ImageHash TargetFileName=/\\(wsc|wwlib|McUtil|goopdate|goopdateres|dwmapi|version|rastls|mcvsmap)\.dll$/i}, field=[aid, TargetProcessId], include=[TargetFileName])
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName, TargetFileName], function=count())
ucs.rationale: Other APTs side-load DLLs, but this exact roster of host binaries — Symantec wsc_proxy.exe, Symantec rastlsc.exe, McAfee mcoemcpy.exe, Kaspersky avpui.exe, Adobe AcroTranscoder.exe — is the Cobalt Kitty / OceanLotus calling card. ucs.title: [LLM] APT32 Office-spawned Squiblydoo / mshta proxy execution with remote SCT or HTA payload
ucs.description: Hunts the OceanLotus phishing-document execution chain: WINWORD/EXCEL/OUTLOOK macro launches regsvr32.exe /s /n /u /i:<URL> scrobj.dll (the classic 'Squiblydoo' SCT loader staging KerrDown / Cobalt Strike) or mshta.exe pulling a remote HTA. Documented in Volexity, ESET and FireEye APT32 reporting as the post-T1204.002 lure-execution step that drops the side-load kit detected by UC1.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name IN ("WINWORD.EXE","EXCEL.EXE","POWERPNT.EXE","OUTLOOK.EXE","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe") AND Processes.process_name IN ("regsvr32.exe","mshta.exe") AND (Processes.process="*scrobj*" OR Processes.process="*/i:http*" OR Processes.process="*/i:\\\\*" OR Processes.process="*javascript:*" OR Processes.process="*vbscript:*" OR Processes.process="*.sct*" OR Processes.process="*.hta*") by host Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_path | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("winword.exe","excel.exe","powerpnt.exe","outlook.exe","wscript.exe","cscript.exe","mshta.exe")
| where FileName in~ ("regsvr32.exe","mshta.exe")
| where ProcessCommandLine matches regex @"(?i)(scrobj|/i:\s*https?://|/i:\s*\\\\[^\\]+|javascript:|vbscript:|\.sct\b|\.hta\b)"
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| extend RemoteResource = extract(@"(?i)(https?://[^\s\"\']+|\\\\[^\s\"\']+)", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage  = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          RemoteResource, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(LookbackDays)
| where EventID == 4688
| where ParentProcessName has_any (@"\WINWORD.EXE", @"\EXCEL.EXE", @"\POWERPNT.EXE", @"\OUTLOOK.EXE", @"\wscript.exe", @"\cscript.exe", @"\mshta.exe")
| where NewProcessName has_any (@"\regsvr32.exe", @"\mshta.exe")
| where CommandLine matches regex @"(?i)(scrobj|/i:\s*https?://|/i:\s*\\\\[^\\]+|javascript:|vbscript:|\.sct\b|\.hta\b)"
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| extend RemoteResource = extract(@"(?i)(https?://[^\s\"\']+|\\\\[^\s\"\']+)", 1, CommandLine)
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, RemoteResource
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: APT32 OceanLotus Office-Spawned Regsvr32 Squiblydoo / Mshta Remote Scriptlet
id: 6e2d1b4c-2c5a-44d2-8d9b-a3e2c4f5d0a8
status: experimental
description: Detects APT32/OceanLotus initial execution where a Microsoft Office host (or a script-host child of one) launches regsvr32.exe or mshta.exe with a remote SCT/HTA URL, UNC path, or scrobj.dll proxy load.
references:
  - https://attack.mitre.org/groups/G0050/
  - https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1218/010/
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/06/19
tags:
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.execution
  - attack.t1218.010
  - attack.t1218.005
  - attack.t1204.002
  - attack.g0050
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\WINWORD.EXE'
      - '\EXCEL.EXE'
      - '\POWERPNT.EXE'
      - '\OUTLOOK.EXE'
      - '\wscript.exe'
      - '\cscript.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\regsvr32.exe'
      - '\mshta.exe'
  selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'scrobj'
      - '/i:http'
      - '/i:\\\\'
      - 'javascript:'
      - 'vbscript:'
      - '.sct'
      - '.hta'
  condition: selection_parent and selection_child and selection_cmd
falsepositives:
  - Internal admin scriptlet kits using regsvr32 /i with trusted UNC paths (allowlist by signed source)
level: high
ucs.datadog_query: source:windows.sysmon @EventID:1 @ParentImage:(*\\WINWORD.EXE OR *\\winword.exe OR *\\EXCEL.EXE OR *\\excel.exe OR *\\POWERPNT.EXE OR *\\powerpnt.exe OR *\\OUTLOOK.EXE OR *\\outlook.exe OR *\\wscript.exe OR *\\WScript.exe OR *\\cscript.exe OR *\\CScript.exe OR *\\mshta.exe OR *\\MSHTA.EXE) @Image:(*\\regsvr32.exe OR *\\RegSvr32.exe OR *\\REGSVR32.EXE OR *\\mshta.exe OR *\\MSHTA.EXE OR *\\Mshta.exe) @CommandLine:(*scrobj* OR *Scrobj* OR *SCROBJ* OR *"/i:http"* OR *"/i:https"* OR *"/i:\\\\"* OR *javascript:* OR *vbscript:* OR *.sct* OR *.SCT* OR *.hta* OR *.HTA*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ParentBaseFileName=/(winword|excel|powerpnt|outlook|wscript|cscript|mshta)\.exe$/i ImageFileName=/(regsvr32|mshta)\.exe$/i
| regex("(scrobj|\\/i:\\s*https?:\\/\\/|\\/i:\\s*\\\\\\\\|javascript:|vbscript:|\\.sct\\b|\\.hta\\b)", field=CommandLine, flags="i")
| RemoteResource := regex("(?<RemoteResource>https?:\\/\\/[^\\s\"']+|\\\\\\\\[^\\s\"']+)", field=CommandLine, flags="i", strict=false)
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ParentBaseFileName, ImageFileName, CommandLine, RemoteResource], function=count())
ucs.rationale: Office → regsvr32/mshta with a remote scriptlet is rare in benign environments; APT32 uniquely chained it with their KerrDown PowerShell loader and KAS shellcode injector — both well-documented by Volexity, ESET, FireEye and Group-IB as OceanLotus exclusives.
